crossRefs.note: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.
He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—
It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t…
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor…
A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money: yet…
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man…
to deprive the needy from justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their…
The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against…
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of…
So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed…
All the people answered, “May his blood be on us, and on our children!”
You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

translations.web: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
translations.bsb: who acquit the guilty for a bribe and deprive the innocent of justice.
translations.kjv: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous
translations.asv: that justify the wicked for a bribe, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
